design: INDIVIDUAL 11: a short ancient council speaker with stocky weathered physique, yellow-brown mottled scales, deep black eye sockets under a broad ridged skull, coarse grey tendrils cropped to uneven shoulder length. A simple ivory tunic under a dark purple mantle, thick red-brown sash and three very large rectangular ancestral medals. Holds a bronze speaking baton horizontally in both hands at stomach level. Bare clawed feet, deliberate balanced posture.
